race.description: Crjc Life Members Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: SYMO'S BOY (4) will be peaking after two runs back from nearly a year off the scene. Went to the front a long way from home last start over 1150m on the Gold Coast Poly and was claimed late in the piece. Strips fitter and gets the gun run for an inside draw. The testing material. UNIVERSAL ENERGY (5) ran a decent race over 1015m here on debut then was looking for more ground at his next run when down the track at Port Macquarie. Blinkers on and this looks a far more pleasing scenario. OPINE (3) started at $4.00 but after going back from a wide alley failed to get involved first-up over this trip at Port Macquarie. Another who may benefit from the addition of shades for the first time. STORMY MARTINI (14) raced handy and showed resilience to hold on for second on debut over 1000m at Port Macquarie recently. Plenty of scope for improvement but will need luck from the wide gate. NO NO NO NO NO (2) has his second run since switching to Matthew Dunn and is a likely improver.
